name: Kobie Marketing
desc:
Customer Care Loyalty Center Representative | $17.00 - $19.00/hr + bonuses |
https://jobs.lever.co/kobie/8b98b2e3-43f7-4139-a6a6-a247b07fa29e
Company: Kobie (Kobie Marketing)
Industry: Customer Loyalty & Rewards Programs | Contact Center
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Kobie is a global loyalty solutions provider that partners with major, well-known brands to run their customer loyalty and rewards programs. As a Customer Care representative, you're the frontline voice customers reach when they have a question about their loyalty program, points, rewards, or account, and your job is genuinely building trust and strengthening that relationship, not just closing tickets.
You'll be handling a high volume of inbound calls, staying current on the specific loyalty program guidelines for whichever brand you're supporting, and using AI-powered agent-assist tools to help you respond faster and more accurately. Beyond answering questions, you're expected to take real ownership of issues through to resolution, de-escalating frustrated callers when needed and escalating anything you can't resolve according to established procedures.
Kobie has real external recognition behind this role, they've won Stevie Awards for outstanding customer service and have been named a Top Workplace USA and Top Remote Workplace, which reflects genuinely above-average employee satisfaction for a call center environment.

This is a solid entry-to-mid level remote customer service opportunity with a reputable employer. The role focuses on supporting customer loyalty and rewards programs rather than sales. Participants with retail, hospitality, banking, healthcare customer service, or prior call center experience will likely be the strongest candidates. The required assessment and emphasis on customer satisfaction metrics suggest Kobie is looking for candidates who are professional communicators and comfortable working in a structured, performance-based environment. The bonus potential and advancement opportunities make this a good long-term option for participants interested in customer service career growth.
assessment: Yes. Required online assessment after application. Candidates who complete the assessment are prioritized for interviews.
